standard_inspiration: ISO/SAE 21434; no standard-defined classification or compliance claim

method.impact: 1 minor operational, 2 significant operational, 3 potential moderate safety effect, 4 potential serious longitudinal safety effect
method.feasibility_ease: 1 demanding privilege/resources, 2 authorized component/state/key compromise, 3 local on-link injection/capture under stated access preconditions
method.score: ordinal product; not probability, expected loss, attack success prediction or normative standard method

assets.AS03: ECU state, brake lamps and supervisor status
assets.AS05: Local diagnostic event integrity and bounded resources
assets.AS06: Test keys, sender authorization and retained freshness state

goals.CG01: Authenticate permitted source and integrity before ECU ingress
goals.CG02: Reject stale/replayed/rolled-back messages without unbounded freshness recovery
goals.CG03: Bound security resource use and expose communication availability loss
goals.CG04: Report security events without initiating blind braking or hiding safety costs
goals.CG05: Separate channel/message keys and explicitly bound trusted-key compromise assumptions

threats.damage_scenario: False obstacle -> unnecessary braking or suppressed true threat
threats.attacker_assumptions: On-link injector without authorized sensor key; may know its own diagnostic key
threats.attack_path: Inject plausible ghost on sensor ingress
threats.impact_rationale: Safety-related longitudinal control or assurance loss; severity is scenario-dependent, not an ASIL assignment.
threats.feasibility_rationale: Local injector is assumed already on the virtual link.
threats.risk_method: Project ordinal impact (1-4) times feasibility ease (1-3); prioritization only
threats.treatment: Authenticate source; retain independent plausibility/fusion gates
threats.residual_risk: Compromised sensor or correlated plausible ghost can remain valid

threats.damage_scenario: Valid emergency demand rejected indefinitely by freshness state

threats.impact_rationale: Safety-related longitudinal control or assurance loss; severity is scenario-dependent, not an ASIL assignment.
